home.name: Shoaib Shafqat
home.intro: — an IT Support & Assistant Hardware Engineer with 2 years of experience in hardware troubleshooting, network infrastructure, Windows systems, and dependable end-user support.

about.lead: I help people and teams stay productive by keeping computers, networks, and everyday IT systems working reliably.
about.body: My approach is practical: identify the issue, troubleshoot methodically, communicate clearly, and document the solution. From Windows deployment and hardware diagnostics to LAN support and meeting-room technology, I enjoy turning technical problems into smooth experiences.

work.intro: Real jobs from hospital IT, from cabling and switches to attendance devices and recovery tools.

contact.title: Have a system to fix or a team to support?
contact.text: Let’s connect to discuss IT support, hardware troubleshooting, and networking opportunities.
